name: Eliezer
overview: Eliezer is a male prophet mentioned in the Bible, identified specifically as the son of Dodavahu. His prophetic role is noted in 2 Chronicles 20:37. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal notes recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliezer means 'G-d is my help,' reflecting a reliance on divine assistance. This proper name is recorded in 2 Chronicles 20:37 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Eliezer is the son of Dodavahu, as stated in 2 Chronicles 20:37. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Eliezer's significance lies in his role as a prophet during the time of the kingdom of Judah, serving as a spiritual messenger and representative of God's guidance. Being identified as the son of Dodavahu situates him within a known family line, emphasizing the continuity of prophetic ministry. His mention in 2 Chronicles 20:37 highlights his contribution to the biblical narrative of divine intervention and instruction.
